name: Visual Genome
description: Visual Genome is a large-scale vision-language dataset of 108,249 real-world Flickr images densely annotated with region descriptions, objects (avg. 21/image), attributes (avg. 16/image), relationships (avg. 18/image), region graphs, scene graphs, and ~1.77M question-answer pairs; all objects, attributes, relationships, and noun phrases are canonicalized to WordNet synsets. It targets comprehensive scene understanding and cognitive tasks by grounding fine-grained visual concepts to language across multiple localized regions per image (avg. ~42 regions/image).
citeAs: Krishna, R., Zhu, Y., Groth, O., Johnson, J., Hata, K., Kravitz, J., Chen, S., Kalantidis, Y., Li, L.-J., Shamma, D. A., Bernstein, M. S., & Fei-Fei, L. Visual Genome: Connecting Language and Vision Using Crowdsourced Dense Image Annotations. arXiv:1602.07332

creator.name: Stanford Vision Lab and collaborators from Stanford University, Yahoo Inc., Snapchat Inc., Dresden University of Technology

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: Images are the 108,249-image intersection of MS-COCO and YFCC100M (Flickr); annotations collected via crowdsourcing include ~42 region descriptions (with bounding boxes) per image, object boxes and co-reference, attributes, pairwise relationships, merged region graphs into scene graphs, and two QA types (freeform and region-based). Canonicalization maps objects, attributes, relationships, and noun phrases to WordNet synsets with MTurk verification; annotations underwent verification via majority voting and rapid judgments.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Collected over 6 months after 15 months of experimentation and iteration (no specific calendar dates provided).
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:annotatorDemographics: Over 33,000 unique AMT workers; 93.02% United States, 1.29% Philippines, 1.13% Kenya, 0.94% India, others; age mainly 25–34 (range 18–68); 54.15% male, 45.85% female; ~94.1% retention; tasks compensated to target ~$6–$8/hour.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: Training and benchmarking for scene understanding, semantic image retrieval, dense/region-based captioning, visual question answering, relationship and attribute prediction, action and interaction recognition, knowledge base construction, and evaluation via scene graphs.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images are user-uploaded Flickr photos; annotations focus on generic scene content (objects, attributes, relationships, QAs). No explicit mention of handling or removal of personal/sensitive data beyond typical Flickr content; dataset contains people and could include incidental PII in images, but policies for PII handling are not described.
